name: Core AI Holdings, Inc.
business_overview: Core AI Holdings, Inc. operates as an AI technology and infrastructure company. The company focuses on identifying, developing, and scaling AI-driven businesses that leverage technologies to address various market opportunities. It is also involved in the AI-driven mobile game development and publishing business. The company is based in Miami, Florida.

classification_meta.logic_summary: Core AI Holdings develops AI-driven technologies and mobile games, generating revenue through game publishing and AI services.

narrative.text:
**Business & market dynamics:** CHAI’s social AI platform sits at the intersection of generative AI and social media, attracting millions of daily users who create and share custom AI personas. Demand is surging, fueled by consumer appetite for interactive, creator-driven AI experiences. The company operates from a talent hub in Palo Alto and benefits from strategic backing by CoreWeave and AMD, which bolsters its infrastructure credibility. With the divestment of a legacy push-to-talk hardware unit, the business is now entirely focused on this high-growth AI-native opportunity, riding secular tailwinds in user-generated AI content.

**Management strategy and execution:** Leadership executed a bold pivot, shedding an underperforming legacy division to concentrate solely on the AI platform. The founder relocated the company from the UK to Palo Alto to access elite engineering talent, driving a culture of rapid iteration that underpins the platform’s scaling. The team has sustained a multi-year streak of rapid expansion, attracted high-profile backers, and signaled ambitious growth aspirations, which has translated into rising market confidence in management’s ability to seize the AI social platform opportunity.

# CHAI AI Surpasses $80 Million ARR At $2.4 Billion Estimated Valuation

By Amit Chowdhry • May 1, 2026

CHAI AI Surpasses $80 Million ARR At $2.4 Billion Estimated Valuation

CHAI AI, a social AI platform backed by CoreWeave and AMD, has surpassed $80 million in annual recurring revenue at the close of Q1 2026, propelling the company to an estimated $2.4 billion valuation. The company has sustained a 3x annual growth rate for three consecutive years and projects ARR to surpass $200 million. Total investment to date has exceeded $55 million.

CHAI AI is building a social AI platform where users can create their own AI and share it with others, and discover and interact with AI built by people they follow. The company positions itself at the intersection of social media and generative AI creation, comparing the current moment in AI to the emergence of social media platforms when video creation became ubiquitous.
